description: This Java class 'PolicyCommandEnforcement' handles authorization enforcement for policy-related commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages checking permissions, filtering response data views based on enforcer policies, and forwarding commands to appropriate regions or handling cache invalidation.

classes.name: PolicyCommandEnforcement
classes.description: Handles authorization enforcement for policy commands, including permission checks, cache invalidation, and forwarding commands within the Eclipse Ditto system.

classes.name: PolicyCommandEnforcement.Provider
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of PolicyCommandEnforcement, providing command class info and change detection logic.

methods.name: authorizePolicyCommand
methods.description: Evaluates whether a policy command is authorized based on the enforcer and command type.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedWritePermission
methods.description: Checks if the enforcer grants unrestricted write permission for a given resource.

methods.name: buildJsonViewForPolicyQueryCommandResponse
methods.description: Filters a PolicyQueryCommandResponse entity view according to the enforcer's permissions.

methods.name: getJsonViewForPolicyQueryCommandResponse
methods.description: Extracts a filtered JSON view of the response entity using the enforcer.

methods.name: transformModifyPolicyToCreatePolicy
methods.description: Converts a ModifyPolicy command into a CreatePolicy command if applicable.

methods.name: errorForPolicyCommand
methods.description: Creates appropriate exceptions for failed policy command enforcement.

methods.name: enforce
methods.description: Main enforcement method, validates commands asynchronously.

methods.name: doEnforce
methods.description: Performs enforcement logic based on whether the enforcer exists.

methods.name: enforcePolicyCommandByEnforcer
methods.description: Executes authorization logic using a provided enforcer.

methods.name: enforcePolicyCommandByNonexistentEnforcer
methods.description: Handles enforcement when no existing enforcer is found, potentially creating policies.

methods.name: forwardToPoliciesShardRegion
methods.description: Forwards commands to the policies shard region.

methods.name: invalidateCaches
methods.description: Invalidates relevant caches when policies change.

methods.name: askPoliciesShardRegionAndBuildJsonView
methods.description: Queries the policies shard region and prepares a JSON view for response.

methods.name: reportTimeoutForPolicyQuery
methods.description: Handles timeout exceptions during policy query responses.

methods.name: reportJsonViewForPolicyQuery
methods.description: Wraps the JSON view building process with error handling.
